sections.overall: One of the biggest stories - and the best match of the week - was Ilja Dragunov's debut against Mike Bailey on Dynamite (8.42). It was exactly as hard-hitting as we hoped it would be! Some of the other focus of the week was the confirming of the Blood And Guts matches, which we look forward to next week!
sections.mens: No other matches in the Men's division came close to the Dynamite main event, though the two singles on Collision (Swerve Strickland vs Myron Reed and Jay White vs Kyle O'Reilly) were decent showings, just over the 7 mark.
sections.womens: The Number One Contender match for the TBS title between Queen Aminata and Maya World (6.5) was the best women's match of the week and a return to the rankings too for World. Also, Marina Shafir and Trish Adora featured in the Collision 8 person tag, though with little changes to their ratings.
sections.menstag: FTR vs The Motor City Machine Guns match 2 of the series was similar in quality to the first one (7.7). The star studded Copeland & Ospreay vs Fletcher & Knight turned out to be a disappointment (6.94), given the talent involved.
sections.womenstag: WrathLander enter the rankings, now that they have had 2 eligible matches, though their showing against Divine Dominion was quite average. The highest-ranked Women's Tag Team just hold onto #1. Blood And Guts could be a chance to boost a few teams' ratings!
sections.trios: No straight Trios this week, though Death Riders and STP both were part of the 8 person tag. Is the Trios division starting to cool off a bit? Hopefully not as this was developing so well in August and September!
